ezgulik.promptDescription: The story should prominently feature acts of kindness, generosity, and compassion. The hero should help others without expecting reward. Kindness shown to strangers, animals, or those in need must be featured.
storyElements: hero helps a stranger in need without being asked
acts of generosity rewarded by the universe
compassion shown to animals or elderly people
sharing food or resources with others
ezgulik.moralTemplate: Yaxshilik qilgan kishiga yaxshilik qaytadi. Mehribon qalb doim baxtli bo'ladi.

halollik.promptDescription: The story should show that honesty and truthfulness are always the right path, even when it is difficult. The hero chooses truth over personal gain.
storyElements: hero tells the truth even when it is scary or costly
dishonesty causes problems and unhappiness
honesty brings trust, friendship, and reward
hero admits a mistake and is respected for it
halollik.moralTemplate: Halollik — eng yaxshi siyosat. Rostgo'y odam har doim hurmat topadi.

odob-axloq.promptDescription: The story should demonstrate the importance of polite behaviour, respectful speech, and good social etiquette in Uzbek culture.
storyElements: polite greetings and farewells shown naturally
respectful speech to elders and teachers
table manners and hospitality in Uzbek tradition
character who is rude learns to be polite
odob-axloq.moralTemplate: Odobli bola hamma joyda hurmatga sazovor bo'ladi. Yaxshi so'z — yurak kaliti.

ilm-marifat.promptDescription: The story should celebrate the power of education, learning, and intellectual curiosity. Knowledge should be shown as a superpower.
storyElements: hero's knowledge or education solves the central problem
studying and hard work at school lead to success
curiosity and asking questions rewarded
wise elder shares knowledge that changes everything
ilm-marifat.moralTemplate: Ilm — eng katta boylik. Bilimli odam har qanday qiyinchilikni yengadi.

kitobxonlik.promptDescription: The story should inspire a love of reading. A book, library, or reading should play a central role in solving the story's problem.
storyElements: hero reads a book that gives them the key to solving the problem
library or bookshop features prominently
reading for pleasure shown as joyful and exciting
hero quotes or applies something they read
kitobxonlik.moralTemplate: Kitob o'qigan odam dunyo ko'radi. Har bir kitob — yangi do'st.

vatanparvarlik.promptDescription: The story should celebrate Uzbek culture, traditions, nature, and heritage. Hero is proud of their homeland and protects or celebrates it.
storyElements: Uzbek national traditions and clothing featured beautifully
hero protects nature, a mountain, river, or garden
national celebration or festival central to the story
pride in Uzbek craftsmanship, food, or history
vatanparvarlik.moralTemplate: Vatanini sevgan odam hamma narsani qo'riqlaydi. Bizning yurtimiz — eng go'zal yurt.

ota-ona-hurmat.promptDescription: The story should show the importance of listening to parents, helping at home, and showing gratitude and respect to family.
storyElements: hero follows parents' advice which turns out to be wise
hero helps parents with household tasks joyfully
hero surprises parents with a kind gesture
character who ignores parents faces difficulty and learns
ota-ona-hurmat.moralTemplate: Ota-onaning ko'nglini xush qilgan bola baxtli bo'ladi. Ularning nasihatida hikmat bor.

ustoz-ehtirom.promptDescription: The story should honour teachers and the education they provide. A teacher's guidance should be central to the story's resolution.
storyElements: teacher's lesson or advice proves crucial to solving the problem
hero expresses gratitude to their teacher
young character helps or defends their teacher
knowledge gained in school used in real life
ustoz-ehtirom.moralTemplate: Ustoz — dunyodagi eng sharafli inson. Ustozni hurmat qilgan o'zi ham hurmatga sazovor bo'ladi.

dostlik.promptDescription: The story should show the power of true friendship — helping each other, standing together through difficulty, and celebrating each other's success.
storyElements: friends help each other through the central challenge
friendship formed between unlikely characters
lonely character's life changed by a new friendship
friends work as a team to solve the problem
dostlik.moralTemplate: Chin do'st — qora kunda bilinadi. Do'stlik — eng katta boylik.

mehnatsevarlik.promptDescription: The story should demonstrate that hard work, persistence, and never giving up always lead to success. Laziness and shortcuts lead to problems.
storyElements: hero persists through multiple failures before succeeding
hard work rewarded at the end of the story
lazy character regrets shortcuts and learns to work hard
small persistent effort builds up to a big result
mehnatsevarlik.moralTemplate: Mehnat — muvaffaqiyatning kaliti. Tirishqoq odam har qanday tog'ni ham hatlab o'tadi.
